low.description: The short central construction has a dark, slightly sloping upper span with descending portions at its two sides and a pale opening beneath the span. Its left descending portion reaches a short rightward lower turn. The right portion is shorter and bends toward the ink immediately on its right. The construction is angular and low relative to the surrounding rounded marks.

high_A.description: The central tall construction has two narrow descending portions beneath a broad transverse upper construction. The upper construction extends left of the descending portions as a flattened pointed arm with a small pale interior, and extends right as a thick, dark, rounded mass. The upper edge is shallowly sloping; it does not rise into a conspicuous high open oval. The descending portions remain visible down to the main writing level, where nearby ink makes their exact attachment less distinct.

high_B.description: The central tall construction has two close, narrow descending portions. Near their upper ends there is a short transverse connection, and a conspicuous open rounded loop rises above and to the right of that connection. The right-hand outline of this loop bulges outward and returns toward the descending construction. A short upward-curving tip is visible on the left side near the connection. The complete upper loop and the space inside it are visible.

discriminating_features: A has a broad, low transverse cap with a thick dark right extension; B has an elevated open rounded loop on the right above a narrower connection.
The highest central ink in B belongs to the top of that open loop. In A the corresponding upper construction stays shallow and broadly spread sideways.
A's flattened left arm and dark right mass must be compared together with B's visible loop outline and pale loop interior; a tall descending portion alone does not distinguish the references.
limitations: These are observations of small raster crops; fine edge texture and faint ink do not establish stroke order or an exact tracing.
Ink from adjacent rows at the crop margins has been excluded from the central constructions.
Nearby ink at the lower writing level makes exact lower attachments less certain than the clearly visible upper differences.
Only the three supplied reference images were inspected. No target images, mappings, transcripts, receipts, or other reports were consulted.
